summary: Integration brief: Agent Loop proposes autonomous-agent work (README.md:53-54); Tool Gate is a Rust library/CLI that evaluates proposed tool invocations and emits allow, deny, or review_required receipts without executing tools (README.md:5-13). Their shared safety boundary is the handoff from agent intent to deterministic pre-execution authorization and auditability (README.md:17-20, README.md:43-48). Recommendation: require every Agent Loop tool proposal to pass a complete ToolMetadata and InvocationEnvelope through Tool Gate, then permit execution only on allow while routing review_required to an operator and recording every receipt. Agent Loop risk: its runtime could bypass or ignore the gate, contrary to the explicit production guidance (README.md:31-33). Tool Gate risk: it is not a sandbox and depends on external authentication, authorization, sandboxing, and runtime enforcement (README.md:156-158). Declared clean-tree check passed exactly as specified; no files were modified.
